overview: Uganda is a landlocked country in East Africa. Its capital and largest city is Kampala. Uganda became independent from the United Kingdom in 1962. English and Swahili are official languages, and the country is home to many ethnic groups. Winston Churchill called it the 'Pearl of Africa'.

geography.text: Uganda sits on a high plateau and includes a large part of Lake Victoria, the largest lake in Africa, from which the Nile begins its long journey north. The Rwenzori Mountains, sometimes called the 'Mountains of the Moon', rise along the western border, and its forests are home to mountain gorillas and chimpanzees.
